clips.title: The story
paras: Across Teldrassil, a curious plant shimmers among the roots and canopy. Travelers bring a cutting to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth, hoping the botanist can explain its origin.
In Teldrassil's boughs, a strange plant catches the light. Its fronds twist with a pulsing shimmer unlike the island's usual foliage. The glow draws the eye amid Teldrassil's young forest life.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The fronds on this plant shimmer in the forest light, giving it a twisting, pulsing aura.
You believe that Denalan would want a specimen of this.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Where did you get this? I haven't seen a plant like this since a sojourn I made to the Swamp of Sorrows... Decades ago! It's amazing that a specimen made its way to Teldrassil. And it's grown to such a size!
Thank you, friend. Forgive my shortness of words, but there is a test I would like to perform on this frond...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
